evidence.claim: Customer reported: Customer C13171 message: 'I never made this $55.68 purchase. Please check my card.' Refers to 3558054.

Flagged transaction 3558054 ($55.68) occurred as part of a 20-minute burst of three nearly identical online authorizations on 2016-12-19: 3557979 ($55.60 at 21:48:32), 3557987 ($55.69 at 21:50:54), and 3558054 ($55.68 at 22:08:56), all sharing device D008431 and recipient domain hotmail.com.

Card C13171-K2 has 18 prior confirmed fraud closed cases out of 19 total closed cases, including CC-3422, CC-3566, CC-3728, and CC-5010, establishing recurring card-not-present fraud vulnerability reported by customer C13171.
Transaction 3558054 does not match any recurring charge pattern for holder C13171-K2|NA|170, and device D008431 is flagged as new to this specific holder baseline.
Card C13171-K2 is located in Louvain community 163578122 exhibiting a fraud lift of 5.0 vs base rate (2 of 4 cards carry confirmed fraud, including C06988-K1 with 9 confirmed fraud cases).
The second-generation fraud model score for transaction 3558054 is low at 0.105 with a historical fraud rate of 21.17%, and legacy risk score is 0.38, yielding no automated model alert.
Device D008431 possesses a generic profile ('unknown | unknown | chrome 66.0 | unknown') observed across 129 cards in the window, with ring_id -1 and zero confirmed fraud cases all-time.
The transaction amount of $55.68 is below the prior maximum transaction ($65.36) for holder C13171-K2|NA|170 and matches the holder's historical product code C and online channel.

case.summary: Customer C13171 reported an unauthorized $55.68 online charge on card C13171-K2 under transaction 3558054. Graph analysis revealed the transaction was part of a 20-minute burst of three near-identical authorizations on 2016-12-19 totaling $166.97. Card C13171-K2 exhibits extensive documented vulnerability with 18 prior confirmed card-not-present fraud cases and no legitimate recurring billing baseline for these amounts. The activity was confirmed as fraudulent with a 0.97 probability, resulting in the card being blocked and a case created.
